name: dash-eval-bench

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && node dist/scripts/assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run build:test && node --test dist/test/*.test.cjs && electron dist/test/desktop-smoke.cjs && electron dist/test/workflow-smoke.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && install-electron && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/package-mac.mts

description: Turn a business outcome into a scored model run.
